15:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Big Day With Peter Schrager
Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories.

16:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: SportsCenter Special
A look at what trade rumors were real and seeing how teams around the NFL are preparing for a championship run or building for the future. With Field Yates, Adam Schefter, Chris Mortensen, Dianna Russini, Mike Tannenbaum and Louis Riddick.
